scenario.title: The Failed Community Fundraiser
scenario.context: Late afternoon at a community center, where a fundraising event has just ended with less success than anticipated.
scenario.description: The annual community center fundraiser, organized by the center's director and a dedicated volunteer, did not meet its financial goal. They are now discussing the event's outcome and planning next steps.
scenario.speaker1_persona: Composed, open, and honest. Expresses his feelings in an appropriate and constructive manner.
scenario.speaker2_persona_1: High EQ - Warm, understanding, and constructive. Expresses her feelings clearly and optimistically.
scenario.speaker2_persona_2: Low EQ - Defensive and dismissive. Responds to Gabriel's feelings with sarcasm and defensiveness.
scenario.speaker2_persona_3: Low EQ - Anxious and irritated. Responds to Gabriel's feelings with anxiety and frustration, failing to express her own feelings adequately.
